msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia caruncho-kodina-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a pair of handmade gold drop earrings with natural baroque pearls and small pink stones from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia caruncho-kodina-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold ring with a rectangular top set with three blue sapphires and small diamonds from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia caruncho-kodina-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a thin gold bangle bracelet with small knots from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia caruncho-kodina-14.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a wide gold ring with a big brilliant-cut white stone and small diamonds from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
